summary: Two index.json changes need matching appearance cards: a new character id (CHAR-duchess-baby) with no card yet, and CHAR-frog-footman's livery colour/badge changing households.

findings.requested_action: Update only the coat colour and badge in your appearance card to the Duchess household's plainer, faded livery (bible/politics.json FAC-duchess-household.emblem_visual), matching the interim handling your own card already anticipated in DEF-p3-appearance-303. No other fields need to change.
